alternative_label_audit.plate_protection: Any non-null package/label among all alternatives prevents whole-plate correction

provenance.feature_source: normalized model output only; no truth labels/ingredients/IDs/camera/dates
provenance.application: Scale candidate estimated_serving_g only; preserve count/unit/density; actual pinned BE arithmetic/rounding
provenance.split_only_metadata: group_id SHA256 modulo 5; group disjoint; standardization fitted on fold training only

feature_rules.count: known count sum plus availability fraction
feature_rules.korean_ngrams: SHA256 signed 64 buckets, lengths 2/3, food mass weighting

provenance.loss: weighted squared error in log grams; training mass weights [0.5,4], weighted centering and unregularized intercept

family_rule.origin: Additional exploratory family and candidate screen requested after observing high-mass deterioration; not a reviewer-prescribed rule
family_rule.alpha_within_family: lowest OOF mass MAE among 10,100,1000; tie lowest alpha
family_rule.family_selection: lowest overall OOF calorie MAE among eligible families
family_rule.eligibility: mass and calorie MAE both improve, all-selected calorie within15 count and valid coverage do not decrease; when truthmass>=400g selected group n>=30, calorie MAE worsening must not exceed 10%
family_rule.linear_negative_prediction: retain original mass/candidates for nonpositive mass, otherwise fixed factor clipping [0.5,2]
family_rule.weighted_log_mass: Final additional development loss hypothesis after log/linear high-mass failures; weight=clip(train truthmass/median(train truthmass),0.5,4); weights never used in inference
